answer: Audits are recorded in wander, queued in meadow, and voyage publishes the wait time. A farm of 223 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 67 identities per epoch. A farm of 1109 identities would post 716 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
